main.title: Summary
text: Frontend engineer with 5 years of experience in fintech and B2B dashboards. Specialised in React, TypeScript and data visualisation; strong focus on accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and component testing.

items.heading: Senior Frontend Engineer — Example Fintech
bullets: Built a trading dashboard in React 18 + TypeScript with real-time updates over WebSockets.
Created chart components with D3.js used across three products.
Led the migration from Create React App to Vite, halving build times.
Mentored two junior developers and ran weekly frontend guild meetings.

items.heading: Frontend Developer — Sample SaaS
bullets: Developed admin panels with Angular and RxJS.
Wrote end-to-end tests with Cypress and unit tests with Jest.
Worked closely with UX designers on a shared design system.
